release_read.basis: Q3 adj EPS $1.03 vs ~$0.89 street and $0.85 guide with gross margin +200bp is a clear beat on a stock with 18.6% short interest, but FY sales guide was cut ($2.91-2.93B vs 2-3% growth before) and the FY EPS range was only maintained, so the Q3 beat implies a softer Q4 ($1.37-1.55) and the CFO's tariff 'upside' did not reach the guide.

key_line.detail: Thesis was the CFO's flagged tariff upside to the earnings outlook. FY adj EPS kept at -high-single to -low-double-digit vs $3.47 ($3.05-3.23) and adj op income at LSD-MSD growth: unchanged despite a ~$0.18 Q3 beat vs guide, so Q4 implied lower ($1.37-1.55 vs $1.90 LY). Net sales guide moderated to $2.91-2.93B from +2-3%. $132m IEEPA refund recovered, excluded from adjusted.

guidance.detail: Sales outlook lowered (~+0.4-1.1% vs +2-3% prior); EPS and op income ranges maintained, i.e. Q3 beat not passed through.

call.detail: Call at 08:30 ET; content not reviewed in the time available. Also announced a leadership-structure change in a separate release.

public_reaction.summary: Only a Turkish headline (getmidas) framing it as a beat: sales +5%? and adjusted operating profit +54%, beat expectations. No analyst actions found in the time available.

thesis_check.note: Margin and EPS beat confirm the setup; the tariff upside did not reach the full-year guide and sales were cut.

expected.open_lag_note: bmo print with the call already done at 08:30; a beat with a held guide on a heavily shorted stock tends to open near the pre-market and give part back early, while bmo names keep repricing through the day.

recommendation.reason: Carter's versloeg de winstverwachting duidelijk (aangepaste winst per aandeel $1,03 tegen circa $0,89 verwacht) met een hogere brutomarge, en het gesprek met analisten is al geweest. Met veel uitstaande shortposities en een melding voor de opening is er ruimte voor verdere stijging gedurende de dag; we houden vast tot het slot in plaats van de standaard 13:00-exit.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs ver boven de verwachte beweging van ruim 9% staat of onder het slot van gisteren zakt, dan liever direct bij de opening verkopen.
